info.title: Autobahn External API
info.description:
# Overview
External API for partners to integrate with Autobahn Security Platform.

## Authentication
All endpoints require JWT Bearer token authentication via OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials flow.

## Query Pattern
This API uses a flexible POST-based query pattern with NobleQuery for complex filtering, field selection, and sorting.

## Filtering
The API supports 5 filter operators for querying data:

### Available Operators
- **equals** - Field value equals one or more values
  - Single value: `{"member": "networkId", "operator": "equals", "values": ["uuid"]}`
  - Multiple values (OR logic): `{"member": "severity", "operator": "equals", "values": ["1", "2"]}`
- **contains** - Field contains substring (case-insensitive)
  - Example: `{"member": "assetName", "operator": "contains", "values": ["prod"]}`
- **startsWith** - Field value starts with prefix (case-insensitive)
  - Example: `{"member": "assetName", "operator": "startsWith", "values": ["10.42"]}`
- **set** - Field is not null/empty (no values array needed)
  - Example: `{"member": "assigneeIds", "operator": "set"}`
- **notSet** - Field is null/empty (no values array needed)
  - Example: `{"member": "assigneeIds", "operator": "notSet"}`

### Filter Structure
Filters are provided as an array. **Multiple filters at the root level are combined with AND logic**.

**Simple filters** (AND logic):
```json
{
  "filters": [
    {"member": "networkId", "operator": "equals", "values": ["98b60120-..."]},
    {"member": "sources", "operator": "equals", "values": ["qualys"]},
    {"member": "maxSeverity", "operator": "equals", "values": ["2", "1"]},
    {"member": "ips", "operator": "contains", "values": ["10.42"]},
    {"member": "assigneeIds", "operator": "notSet"}
  ]
}
```
This translates to: `networkId = X AND sources = qualys AND (severity = 1 OR severity = 2) AND ips CONTAINS '10.42' AND assigneeIds IS NULL`

**Complex filters** with OR/AND logic:
```json
{
  "filters": [
    {"member": "title", "operator": "contains", "values": ["harden"]},
    {
      "or": [
        {"member": "assigneeIds", "operator": "equals", "values": ["791e6005-..."]},
        {"member": "assigneeIds", "operator": "notSet"},
        {"member": "status", "operator": "equals", "values": ["ToDo"]}
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```
This translates to: `title CONTAINS 'harden' AND (assigneeIds = X OR assigneeIds IS NULL OR status = 'ToDo')`

You can also nest logical groups:
```json
{
  "filters": [
    {
      "or": [
        {"member": "severity", "operator": "equals", "values": ["5"]},
        {
          "and": [
            {"member": "severity", "operator": "equals", "values": ["4"]},
            {"member": "status", "operator": "equals", "values": ["ACTIVE"]}
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```
This translates to: `severity = 5 OR (severity = 4 AND status = 'ACTIVE')`

## Time-Based Filtering
For date/time filtering, use the **timeDimensions** field instead of filters:

```json
{
  "timeDimensions": [
    {
      "dimension": "lastScannedAt",
      "dateRange": ["2025-11-02T17:00:00.000Z", "2025-11-03T16:59:59.999Z"]
    }
  ]
}
```

### Important Notes
- Multiple filters are combined with **AND logic**
- Multiple values in a single `equals` filter use **OR logic**
- Text search with `contains` and `startsWith` is case-insensitive
- The `set` and `notSet` operators do not require a `values` array
- Date ranges must be specified in **timeDimensions**, not in filters
- Date ranges require exactly 2 ISO 8601 formatted timestamps: [start, end]

## Rate Limiting
- Default: 1000 requests/hour per organization
- Burst: 20 requests/second
- Headers: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset

post.description:
Authenticate using external API credentials to obtain a JWT access token.

**Token Details:**
- Token expires in 12 hours
- Use token in Authorization header: `Bearer <token>`
- Token includes permissions array for authorized operations

**Note:** This endpoint does not require authentication (it provides the token).

post.description:
Flexible endpoint for querying assets. Supports multiple use cases:

**1. Get all assets**: Query with filters, dimensions, and sorting

**2. Get asset details**: Filter by specific assetId to get detailed asset information including port overview (closedPort, openPort)

getAllAssets.summary: Get all assets with basic fields

getAssetDetails.summary: Get specific asset details with counts

comprehensiveFilters.summary: Comprehensive filtering example with all available fields

post.description:
Get detailed information about ports for specific assets. Returns port-level data including state, protocol, service name, and vulnerability severity.

Typically used with assetId filter to retrieve all ports for a specific asset.

getPortDetails.summary: Get port details for specific asset

post.description:
Retrieve all available asset tags for the organization. Used to populate filter dropdowns.

Returns lightweight catalog data (~20-50 tags) optimized for UI components.

Bulk operation to assign users to one or more assets.

This endpoint will:
- Add the specified assignees to all provided assets
- Skip assignees that are already assigned to an asset
- Return success count and any errors encountered

Bulk operation to remove assigned users from one or more assets.

This endpoint will:
- Remove the specified assignees from all provided assets
- Skip assignees that are not assigned to an asset
- Return success count and any errors encountered

Bulk operation to add tags to one or more assets.

This endpoint will:
- Add the specified tags to all provided assets
- Skip tags that are already applied to an asset
- Return success count and any errors encountered

Bulk operation to remove tags from one or more assets.

This endpoint will:
- Remove the specified tags from all provided assets
- Skip tags that are not applied to an asset
- Return success count and any errors encountered

Flexible endpoint for querying issues. Handles all filtering scenarios:

**Use cases:**
- Get all issues with filters
- Get issues for specific vulnerability_id
- Get issues for specific asset_id
- Get issues by status, severity, scan_type, etc.

**Response includes:**
- Total count of matching issues
- Paginated list of issue instances
- Each issue shows where the vulnerability was found (asset, port, etc.)

Get knowledge base issue details for a specific vulnerability.

**Includes:**
- Vulnerability definition (CVE, description, mitigation)
- CVSS scores and EPSS percentile
- Workout/remediation information
- **Count-by-status**: How many instances exist in each status (NEW, ACTIVE, REMEDIATED, etc.)

**Note:** If severity <= 1 (informational), workout data is removed.

Flexible endpoint for querying security scans. Supports filtering, sorting, and pagination.

Use this endpoint to:
- Get list of all scans with filtering
- Get scan details by filtering with scanId
- Includes severity distribution and issue counts

The response includes:
- Scan metadata (name, type, state, origin)
- Asset count
- Severity counts (critical, high, medium, low)
- Assignee information
- Timestamps (started, finished, created, updated)

Bulk operation to reassign assignees for one or more scan configurations.

This endpoint allows you to:
- Replace existing assignees with new assignees for scan configs
- Update assignees for multiple scan configurations at once
- Modify who receives notifications and has access to scan results

**Note:** This updates the scan configuration, which affects all future scans created from this configuration.

Invite a new team member to the organization.

Email validation is automatically performed as part of the invite process.
The system checks if:
- Email is already registered in the organization
- Email format is valid
- User can be invited

If the email is already registered, the invitation will be rejected.

bearerAuth.description:
JWT Bearer token obtained via OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials flow.

**Token Request:**
```
POST https://autobahn.auth0.com/oauth/token
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "client_id": "your-client-id",
  "client_secret": "your-client-secret",
  "audience": "https://api.autobahn-security.com",
  "grant_type": "client_credentials"
}
```

x-enum-descriptions.equals: Field value equals one of the provided values (OR logic for multiple values)

Filter.description:
Single filter condition. Multiple filters in an array are combined with AND logic.

Examples:
- `{"member": "networkId", "operator": "equals", "values": ["uuid"]}` - Exact match
- `{"member": "assetName", "operator": "contains", "values": ["prod"]}` - Text search
- `{"member": "maxSeverity", "operator": "equals", "values": ["1", "2"]}` - Multiple values (OR logic)

values.description: Values to filter by (one or more values)

FilterGroup.description:
Filter group that can be either a simple filter or a logical grouping (AND/OR).

Supports nested logic for complex queries:
- Simple filter: `{"member": "status", "operator": "equals", "values": ["active"]}`
- OR logic: `{"or": [filter1, filter2, filter3]}`
- AND logic: `{"and": [filter1, filter2]}`
- Nested: `{"or": [simpleFilter, {"and": [filter1, filter2]}]}`

oneOf.description: Logical OR grouping - matches if ANY condition is true

or.description: Array of filters/groups combined with OR logic

oneOf.description: Logical AND grouping - matches if ALL conditions are true

and.description: Array of filters/groups combined with AND logic

TimeDimension.description:
Time-based dimension for filtering by date ranges.

Use this for filtering time-based fields like lastScannedAt, createdAt, etc.
Date ranges use AND logic (between start and end dates).

Example:
- `{"dimension": "lastScannedAt", "dateRange": ["2025-11-02T17:00:00.000Z", "2025-11-03T16:59:59.999Z"]}`

- AuthError: 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden
- ResourceNotFoundError: 404 Not Found
- InternalError: 5xx Server Errors
